svg.aria-label: Four geographic modes of speciation and a genome scan showing islands of divergence with an inversion
svg.text: Ranked by how much gene flow divergence must beat

g.text: isolation is an incidental BY-PRODUCT of independent divergence
a cline forms; loci with s > m stay differentiated, the rest are swamped
SYMPATRIC — full gene flow, and the hard case
recombination breaks the ecology–preference association EVERY generation
— unless a magic trait or an inversion removes it from the problem

svg.text: Genome scan of a parapatric pair
The condition, locus by locus: s > m
Local selection must exceed the migration rate,
or the locally adapted allele is swamped.
Inside an inversion the block needs only ∑s_i > m
Caution: a WIDE divergent region is evidence of suppressed recombination, not of many selected sites.
